audience: vacation rental managers who run properties, bookings and guest messages in Hostfully

useCases.title: Check which bookings arrive soon
useCases.text: The AI searches leads (bookings, inquiries and calendar blocks) by property and check-in or check-out date. It shows status, channel, dates and guest info.

useCases.title: Price a stay and check if a property is open
useCases.text: The AI reads the day-by-day calendar and pricing periods of a property, and calculates a quote with rent, fees, taxes and deposit. Nothing is created.

useCases.title: Read guest messages and reviews
useCases.text: The AI reads guest messages from a lead, a thread or the whole agency, and the reviews of a property with rating, content and host response.

useCases.title: See scheduled cleanings and other jobs
useCases.text: The AI lists jobs such as cleanings and greetings in a date window, filtered by property and status. It also lists the services with provider and duration.

useCases.title: Reply to a guest or schedule a job
useCases.text: The AI sends a message to the guest of a lead by email or on the booking channel, or schedules a job such as a cleaning at a property.
